__Rewards for The Big Bloom__ 

Downloadable & Printable copies can be found __here__.

Flower Crown Crafting Calculator can be found __here__.

**Reward Checklist**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_bf9dc0752e6f4336b2a726aa759eaefd~mv2.png)

__Rewards__

This guide is broken into the following sections:

- Base Rewards
- Default Rewards
- Base Flowers
- Common Rewards
- Rare Rewards

Flower Crowns and Outfits can be traded after crafting by dropping them or placing them in Camp Vendors. However, they cannot be scrapped or sold to Robot Vendors.

__Base Rewards__

XP - 300 (base)

Caps - 100 (base)

Legendary Modules - 1

Murmrgh's Mystery Pick - 1x 3* item

Treasury Notes - 3

Hybrid Flower - Candykill

Hybrid Flower - Embergold

Hybrid Flower - Gigablossom

Hybrid Flower - Glorybell

Hybrid Flower - Green Invader

Hybrid Flower - Seesprout

Hybrid Flower - Starlace

**Player Title: Gardener**

Suffix

- Has learned Plan: Flower Crown - Carnal Weeper
- Has learned Plan: Flower Crown - Crystalcup
- Has learned Plan: Flower Crown - Radlily

Released: 2025

Hey there, I'm Kat, also known as Duchess!

I'm an Aussie data miner who creates guides for farming, events, and food buffs in Fallout 76.

I firmly believe that knowledge should be accessible to everyone, so my guides will always be free. However, maintaining a website and using photo and video editing software can be costly.

If you find my guides useful, here are a few ways you can support me:

- Share My Guides: Help your fellow vault dwellers by sharing my guides.

- __Follow Me on Social Media:__ Keep up with my latest updates by following me on social media.

- __One-Time Donation:__ Buy me a coffee.

- __Monthly Contribution:__ Become a regular supporter by subscribing to my Ko-fi page.

Every bit of support helps cover the costs of creating these guides and maybe even gets me a cup of coffee or three ;)

Thanks for your support!
